title: Konsert Kita Suara Anti Buli 2026 — Platinum Sponsorship
summary: Platinum RM300k: UiTM Shah Alam Mar/Apr 2026, Bella Astillah, Nadeera, Alpha + theme song & contests.
description: Official sponsorship deck (9 pages, organised by Nusavue). 2-hour musical movement vs bullying: empathy/resilience, e-voucher per ticket, Contest x Konsert, artist photoshoot, meet & greet. Line-up Alpha, Bella Astillah (TikTok Celebrity 2024), Nadeera (Big Stage S5). Mixed seated 1,600 or 3,000 mix, 3–5M impressions. Brand as champion + viral content + nationwide goodwill.
